newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain six-month bill yields seen stable at auction.
newsitem.headline: Spain six-month bill yields seen stable at auction.

text.p: Spanish six-month bills should show an unchanged yield at 5.31 percent at an auction on Wednesday expected to draw lukewarm interest, dealers said.
The marginal yield was expected to be fixed around 5.35 and 5.40 pct, despite very rare prices in the grey market.
At its previous auction on February 12, Spain's Treasury saw a rise in the marginal yield to 5.351 percent from 5.342 percent two weeks earlier.
"There are few bids on this maturity and there are no prices on the grey market" a dealer said.
